title: Page 24
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n Mar 17th 1864 230 P. M
Happy Enoch Marshall Henrietta To Bellows The fur
loughed Webbs from Quotient Talbot White are repeated
to rend - ez - vous here Tulip Mud asks
for Baker waynes of Pekin & Allen or
Brooks Waylands of Sugar to be sent to
Bremen Yacht Lapland Watsons that the Gilbert Agate
Pedlar repeated to his Quotient have been dismounted
at Holland & the Silvers sent to your
repeats Pike and that other Silvers collected there 
for his Princeton have been diverted Tulip I
Saxon these quitmans may inter saxon with his
Suppers sig Lady Spunky Shark Chief of Satan


Caldwell  Mar 23rd
S H Beckwith Charts Pigeon Opera to or is
with him here & will accompany him in the
field works no one & two Pigeon competent man


S.H. Beckwith ( 2 )  Washn Mar 25th 1864 
Imogene For Madrid Yacht Arnold Waynes of heavy Pagan
numb ering about Benton Dwight Summer are repeated to
Persia talbot Advent and will leave Panther they can
be rep laced by summer from other Sacos tulip
Please direct Mohawk to Whiff Lantern where they are
to land Yawl Cupid do not use any words
from them extra pages until I receive my book
